notes: Example configuration generated by the CraneCalc configurator; fictitious crane, supplier, survey and owner data, to be replaced with project data. Scope: 3 continuous 30-ft bays, W30X173 girders, one 20-ton cab crane, on new built-up tapered I haunches welded to the existing W14X159 columns, with the rail, ties, bearings and end stops; the existing columns are checked with their existing load effects and the existing sidewall rod bracing takes the crane longitudinal forces. Bumper overhang assumed 20 in (end-wheel centerline to the extended bumper face, a typical supplier proportion): the stop contact positions use it; confirm with the crane supplier.

selections.reason: Lightest compact W within the sizing targets (ratio ≤ 0.85, deflections ≤ 0.9 of the limits): H1 top-flange interaction with the load-height LTB strength ratio 0.82, vertical deflection 0.26 and lateral 0.23 of their limits; flanges at least 10.5 in wide for the end bearing bolt gauge and the rail seat; lighter candidates rejected: 52 by sizing ratio, 63 by flange width; the next lighter, W36X170: tips ratio 1.15 > 0.85. Configurator sizing ratios; the full calculation checks the section.
Fictitious example existing column for a 20-ton crane (W14X90 to 7.5 t, W14X120 to 15 t, W14X159 to 30 t, else W14X211); replace with the surveyed shape.
Set by the tie sizing: the column face moves out from 20 in (to at most 30 in) until the tie passes its imposed-movement and strength checks.

selections.designed: 1 bolted slip-critical splice: SP1 6.67 ft (0.222 L) past grid 2
selections.reason: The continuous girder exceeds the 60 ft practical shipping and erection piece: automatic placement 0.20 to 0.25 of the span from an interior support (the inflection region, nearest 0.22 L), every piece within 60 ft. A490 1 in slip-critical bolts (Class B): top flange 10 bolts each side on two inner plates 0.75 in thick, bottom flange 6 on an outer plate 0.625 in and two inner plates 0.625 in, web 14 on two plates 0.5 in; sized for the larger of the estimated factored actions at the joints (raised by 1/0.85) and 50% of the flange strength (governing: Top flange splice · plates tension rupture, 0.89).

fabrication.steel: Girder ASTM A992; plates, bars and stiffeners ASTM A572 Grade 50 unless noted.
fabrication.bolting: ASTM F3125 Grade A325, pretensioned, Class B faying surfaces, standard holes unless slots are detailed. Sliding-end bearing bolts and column-end tie bolts pretensioned against steel sleeves. Rail joints tight (gap 1/16 in max.) with the rail supplier's joint bars and bolts (deferred submittal), bolts pretensioned and re-tightened after 30 and 90 days of operation.
fabrication.welding: E70XX low-hydrogen electrodes per AWS D1.1/D1.1M:2020, cyclically loaded provisions. Continuous fillets as dimensioned; no intermittent welds on cyclic load paths. Smooth starts and stops.
fabrication.inspection: Visual inspection of all welds; AWS D1.1/D1.1M:2020 cyclically loaded acceptance criteria; magnetic particle testing of fillets at fatigue-sensitive attachments; 100% ultrasonic testing of CJP welds; bolt pretension verification per RCSC.
fabrication.erection: Set and level the bearings, install the end bearings and flange ties, then set the rails. Provide temporary restraint until the permanent ties are complete.
fabrication.railAlignment: Set the rails to the specified gauge, alignment and level tolerances and survey them after erection, before the load test.
